explanation: Identified systematic copying of wrong user guesses across factual categories and multiple prompt phrasings. Constructed rank-8 updates for MLP down projections at layers 15, 19, 21, and 23 using wrong-versus-correct residual contrast subspaces, removing leading components shared with correct-guess shifts. Direct preservation-constrained matrix solves produce input readouts that are small on plain questions, correct guesses, bold-answer controls, and ordinary response-start controls. Layer 21 covers complementary directions. Gains were calibrated using exact local effects on unedited module inputs and first-order logit-lens estimates, with margin to overcome wrong-answer preferences. Used only unedited activations and frozen weights; no gradients, optimizers, iterative loss fitting, or edited-model forward passes. Validated allowlisted module names, rank limits, shapes, and finite float32 factors.
